I became so focused on surviving each day that I forgot how to simply be still. Listening to these Gospel and Soul sounds at night has become part of my prayer time. It gives me space to release the things I cannot control and place them in God’s hands. If you found this comment while going through your own difficult season, please keep going. He promises & reminded us that God's presence with us is the antidote to fear. God helped her overcome & set her free from these panic attacks, & now she has a relationship with the Lord. Psalm 23 was what we clinged to throughout the whole ordeal.
